authority_boundary.operator: determines mission direction and authorizes external/destructive mutations
authority_boundary.apex_control_plane: binds execution intent, route policy, verification requirements, and receipts
authority_boundary.akos: provides provenance-bound observation and epistemic support
authority_boundary.compute_fabric: selects a verified backend from the declared workload class without acquiring project authority
authority_boundary.buildkite: executes and reports operator-directed private/general workloads when selected by the compute fabric
authority_boundary.public_action_face: executes explicitly catalog-admitted governed GitHub workloads
authority_boundary.connector_worker_fabric: executes provider-native event/sync operations under connector policy
authority_boundary.github_actions_private: exception-only compatibility route; never the default scheduler

compute_fabric.purpose: route compute by declared workload class to an eligible verified backend such as Buildkite or OCI without conflating scheduler choice with authority

buildkite_verified_execution.purpose: private CI, deterministic validation, short/medium general execution, and other workloads currently proven on Buildkite

public_action_face.purpose: explicitly admitted governed GitHub workloads through public GitHub-hosted execution, OIDC, Keymaster, and short-lived repository-scoped credentials

connector_worker_fabric.purpose: provider-native sync, webhook, polling, inventory, and mutation work with idempotency, leases, provider identity, and receipts

private_github_actions_exception.purpose: temporary compatibility or narrowly justified private GitHub-hosted execution

none.purpose: repository or artifact has no active execution requirement
